title: Finite global Ext for coherent complexes on a proper scheme
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a proper scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Work with Zariski sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $K,E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ have coherent cohomology sheaves [pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose $H^i(K)=0$ for all sufficiently large $i$ and $H^i(E)=0$ for all sufficiently negative $i$. For every integer $n$, the $A$-module
$$\operatorname{Ext}^n_X(K,E)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(K,E[n])$$
is finitely generated, where the $A$-action comes from $f$.

source.place: Tag 0D0D (lemma-ext-finite), K in D^-_Coh and L in D^+_Coh. This statement is on the Zariski site, unlike spaces-perfect.tex Tag 0D0T.

proof.text: Put $Y=\operatorname{Spec}A$. Its single affine chart has Noetherian coordinate ring $A$, so $Y$ is locally Noetherian by [pqf-def-locnoeth]; it is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs], hence Noetherian. Properness includes finite type by [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to $f$ to see that $X$ is Noetherian, in particular locally Noetherian.

Let $G=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(K,E)$. By [lem-sfb-scheme-coherent-derived-internal-hom], $G$ has coherent cohomology and is bounded below: step 1 supplies local Noetherianity, and the two coherent inputs have exactly the upper bound on $K$ and lower bound on $E$ that the lemma requires.

Apply [lem-sfb-proper-scheme-coherent-derived-image] to $f:X\to Y$ and $G$. The base $Y$ is Noetherian by step 1, $f$ is proper by hypothesis, and $G$ has bounded below coherent cohomology by step 2. Thus $T=Rf_*G$ has bounded below coherent cohomology on the Zariski site of $Y$.

Use [lem-trf-open-ext-hypercohomology-comparison] for the ringed space $X$, the open $U=X$, and $i=n$. It gives $H^nR\Gamma(X,G)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(K,E[n])$. This comparison is $A$-linear, not just additive: for $a\in A$ apply its stated naturality in the second argument to $a\,\mathrm{id}_E$. On a representative Hom complex this sends $\varphi$ to $a\varphi$; on derived Hom it is postcomposition by $a\,\mathrm{id}_{E[n]}$. These are exactly the two structure-morphism scalar actions.

source.place: Tag 08DK (lemma-section-RHom-over-U), with shifts; displayed identification in perfect.tex Tag 0D0D.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-derived-sections-pushforward-comparison] with $U=Y$. It gives $R\Gamma(Y,T)\cong R\Gamma(X,G)$ in the derived category of abelian groups. Its naturality in $G$ intertwines the endomorphism $a\,\mathrm{id}_G$ for every $a\in A$. Since module direct image gives the target-ring action through $f$, these are multiplication by $a$ on both section complexes; consequently its cohomology comparisons are $A$-linear. Together with step 4, this identifies the desired Ext module with $H^nR\Gamma(Y,T)$.

source.place: Tag 0D0D, Leray equality; Tag 08D5 (lemma-quasi-coherence-direct-image), proof, derived-section comparison.

proof.text: By [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth], every $H^j(T)$ is quasi-coherent. Apply [lem-pc-affine-derived-sections-homology-comparison] to derived global sections on $Y=\operatorname{Spec}A$, using the scalar identification $\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)=A$. It gives an $A$-module isomorphism $H^nR\Gamma(Y,T)\cong\Gamma(Y,H^n(T))$. The latter is finitely generated by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-affine-sections-finite]. The inverse images of a finite generating set under the composite of this isomorphism and step 5 generate the Ext module: the composites preserve sums and multiplication by each $a\in A$. This proves the assertion for every integer $n$, including those below the lower cohomological bound.
